cases.name: read-winget-interactive-granted

cases.name: read-winget-long-option-prefix

cases.name: read-winget-long-option-text-before-equals

cases.name: read-winget-triple-hyphen

cases.name: read-winget-single-hyphen
cases.note: '-' has no other character, so it names no option.

cases.name: read-winget-override-value-not-option
cases.note: The next element is the option's value and is not read as an option. Control: read-winget-attached-value-frees-next.

cases.name: read-winget-attached-value-frees-next
cases.note: With an attached value the next element is read as an option; opt-ins are named in table order.

cases.name: read-winget-override-missing-value
cases.note: An option that takes no value still has its effect.

cases.name: read-winget-short-o-not-listed

cases.name: read-winget-cluster-names-each
cases.note: '-ei' names '-e' and '-i'.

cases.name: read-winget-terminator-before
cases.note: No element after '--' names an option.

cases.name: read-winget-location
cases.note: The location is granted only for C:\Apps and C:\Apps=1.

cases.name: read-winget-location-ungranted
cases.note: The location is granted only for C:\Apps and C:\Apps=1. Shows that the option's value is the location.

cases.name: read-winget-location-short
cases.note: The location is granted only for C:\Apps and C:\Apps=1.

cases.name: read-winget-location-short-ungranted
cases.note: The location is granted only for C:\Apps and C:\Apps=1.

cases.name: read-winget-location-short-wrong-case
cases.note: The location is granted only for C:\Apps and C:\Apps=1. '-L' is not in the table, so no location is set. Control: read-winget-location-short-ungranted.

cases.name: read-winget-location-long-any-case
cases.note: The location is granted only for C:\Apps and C:\Apps=1.

cases.name: read-winget-location-attached
cases.note: The location is granted only for C:\Apps and C:\Apps=1.

cases.name: read-winget-location-attached-quoted
cases.note: The location is granted only for C:\Apps and C:\Apps=1. A leading and a trailing '"' are removed from an attached value.

cases.name: read-winget-location-short-attached
cases.note: The location is granted only for C:\Apps and C:\Apps=1.

cases.name: read-winget-location-short-attached-quoted
cases.note: The location is granted only for C:\Apps and C:\Apps=1.

cases.name: read-winget-location-attached-first-equals
cases.note: The location is granted only for C:\Apps and C:\Apps=1. The value is the text after the first '='.

cases.name: read-winget-location-attached-one-quote
cases.note: Only a leading '"': not removed, and '"' makes the path not plain (§install-location).

cases.name: read-winget-location-next-element-quoted
cases.note: Quotes are removed only from an attached value; '"' makes the path not plain.

cases.name: read-winget-location-missing-value
cases.note: --location with no value gives no install location, so the request fails the install location check.

cases.name: read-winget-location-in-cluster
cases.note: '-l' is not the only short option of its element, so it takes no value and gives no location.

cases.name: read-winget-location-after-terminator
cases.note: The location is granted only for C:\Apps and C:\Apps=1. After '--' nothing names an option, so no location is used.
